meta.notes: All timestamps are local to timeZone; stage/stream/workout times use MM-dd HH:mm:ss format anchored at 2026-09-10 (Europe/Prague). Consecutive same-stage sleep intervals are merged. Sessions carry stageTotalsSec (per-stage totals), awakenings (merged awake segments), sleepEfficiencyPct (asleep/duration), unrecordedSec (time between stage segments with no data), and inBedPartial (true when the in-bed source covered less of the night than the stages, making inBedSec smaller than asleepSec). Vitals are summarized per session with min/avg/max/p50/p90 and per-stage averages; oxygenSaturation is percent. Streams are tuples ordered by tupleSchema with a hoisted unit and sources list; every tuple ends in sourceIdx (an index into sources) regardless of how many writers there are, and anonymized exports keep the column with pseudonymous source names. Dense streams carry downsampledTo and are avg/min/max bins (verbose exports keep full resolution). Workouts carry per-km splits and, in compact exports, a perMinute series (avg HR/power/cadence and distance per elapsed minute); verbose exports replace perMinute with raw streams in the same tuple shape. averagePaceSecPerKm/averageSpeedKmh are omitted below 100 m of distance. Swims carry swimmingLocation (pool/openWater; Apple's isIndoor flag is unreliable for swims), lapLengthM, swimmingStrokeCount and water temperature; dives carry averageDepthM/maxDepthM and water temperature, with underwaterDepth/waterTemperature streams when verbose. weatherHumidityPercent is 0–100. Activity daily summaries use local-time day buckets with source-deduplicated sums (matches the Health app; overlapping iPhone/Watch samples are not double-counted); distance is in kilometres. additional.* sections report one row per day; their aggregation map says whether each metric is a daily sum, average of readings, or the day's latest reading. additional.heart.streams carries all-day heart rate and blood oxygen (every sample in the range, awake or asleep) in the same tuple shape as sleep.streams: 5-minute avg/min/max bins in standard exports, every sample when verbose; oxygenSaturation is percent. additional.mindfulSessions lists every mindful session with its writer (mind.daily keeps the per-day totals). additional.medications is the current medication list; additional.medicationDoses and additional.sexualActivity are per-event logs. Sleep sessions overlapping the range are included in full, so stages/streams may extend outside the range. Daily rows with no recorded data are omitted, and a range ending mid-day means the last day is partial.
